blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine sepak takraw team wound up with a bronze medal in men’s regu of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games after falling to powerhouse Malaysia, 10-15, 15-11, 15-7, in the semifinals on Monday at Mizuho Park Gymnasium. The team of Jason Huerte, Jom Lerry Rafael, Reynaldo Asilum, Glindel Phori and Ronsited Gabayeron couldn’t sustain its early form and lost its chance to vie for a gold medal. With the loss, the Philippines equaled its first medal from three years ago at the pandemic-delayed 2022 Hangzhou edition. Huerte, Rafael and […]...
